mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 134,000 thousand persons indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening cycle in a strong labor market, which typically precedes economic overheating and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing starts level below 1950 thousand units signals a weakening housing sector that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 1950 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index below 108 (INDPRO) signals a contraction in industrial output that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 108, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and residential sales and financial services (RSAFS) indicates strong labor market conditions and consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the past three months signals persistent inflation that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods with rising CPIAUCSL (month-over-month), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
